description: Example connector showing filesystem access: notes stored in the connector's private host directory.
instructions: Copy this folder to start a connector that reads and writes files in its private host directory, seen by the connector as /data. The host only offers filesystem access when its operator enabled it, and installs the connector only after the user acknowledges the permission. Tools take a note name, never a raw path; the connector maps names into /data/notes itself.
name: example-fs
title: Example: Files

tools.description: Write a note by name, creating it if needed.
